Used these brackets to mount 2 x 500w solar panels to the roof of my gazebo at camp. Have held up through strong wind storms. The adjustability is great to help get the perfect angle. Highly recommended!

I purchased several sets of the Solar Panel Mounting Brackets in August 2026. I am mounting solar panels on the roof of my mobile home. I selected these mounts because the angle of these mounts is adjustable to match my latitude. I like the sturdy, simple, and light weight design of the mounts. Each mount includes 4 sets of size M6 (metric) stainless steel bolts, nuts, flat washers, and lock washers to mount a single solar panel to each mount. I was pleased to discover that I could easily order additional stainless steel M6 bolts, nuts, flat washers and lock washers from Lowes. I recommend the mounts be mounted on a rigid surface, such as my roof. The strength of the mounts depends upon being mounted to a rigid surface.
